text:
```yaml
name: Claude Code
on:
  issue_comment:
    types: [created]
  pull_request_review_comment:
    types: [created]
  issues:
    types: [opened, edited]

jobs:
  claude-code:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
      issues: read
      pull-requests: read
      discussions: read
    steps:
      - name: Check for @claude mention
        id: check_mention
        run: |
          COMMENT_BODY="${{ github.event.comment.body }}"
          if [[ "$COMMENT_BODY" == *@claude* ]]; then
            echo "claude_mentioned=true" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          fi

      - name: Claude Code Action
        if: env.claude_mentioned == 'true'
        uses: claude-ai/claude-code@v1
        with:
          github_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          claude_api_key: ${{ secrets.CLAUDE_API_KEY }}
          # Additional configuration can be added here
```
